verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents a public REST API for deployed crews: POST /kickoff starts a run, GET /status/{kickoff_id} reports its status, and POST /resume continues it with human feedback. That API is tied to the AMP managed deployment, covers only execution control (kickoff, status, resume), and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, API coverage beyond run/status/resume (e.g. creating or configuring agents, tasks and crews), clarity on availability outside the enterprise AMP tier, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
